sections.heading: Telling a whole story
sections.body:
Real stories weave the two tenses together. A simple recipe:

1. **Set the scene** (imperfect): time, place, weather, people, what was going on. *Era un sábado. Hacía sol y yo estaba en el mercado con mi hermana.*
2. **Tell the events** (preterite), in order: *De repente, un hombre se acercó y me preguntó la hora. Le dije la hora y se fue.*
3. **Describe reactions and states** during the story (usually imperfect): *Yo estaba un poco nerviosa.*
4. **Finish** (preterite): *Al final, volvimos a casa y le contamos todo a mi madre.*

sections.heading: Verbs that change meaning
sections.body: A few verbs say something slightly different in each tense:

head: Verb
Imperfect
Preterite
rows: *pude* — I managed to · *no pude* — I failed to

sections.heading: The same sentence, two meanings
sections.body: *Tenía que trabajar* (I was supposed to work — maybe I did, maybe not) vs. *Tuve que trabajar* (I had to work — and I did). *Iba a llamarte* (I was going to call you — but didn't) is a very common way to excuse yourself.

vocab: to happen / to pass / to spend (time)
I was supposed to / had to
examples: Era un sábado y hacía sol.
It was a Saturday and it was sunny.
Yo estaba en el mercado con mi hermana.
I was at the market with my sister.
De repente, un hombre se acercó.
Suddenly, a man came up to us.
Me preguntó la hora.
He asked me the time.
Le dije la hora y se fue.
I told him the time and he left.
Yo estaba un poco nerviosa.
I was a bit nervous.
Al final, volvimos a casa y le contamos todo a mi madre.
In the end, we went home and told my mother everything.
¿Qué pasó?
What happened?
Conocía a su hermano, pero no a ella.
I knew her brother, but not her.
La conocí en una fiesta.
I met her at a party.
Sabía la verdad.
I knew the truth.
Supe la verdad el lunes.
I found out the truth on Monday.
Quería ir, pero no pude.
I wanted to go, but I couldn't.
No quise comer.
I refused to eat.
Tenía que trabajar, pero me quedé en casa.
I was supposed to work, but I stayed home.
Tuve que trabajar el domingo.
I had to work on Sunday.
Iba a llamarte, pero se me olvidó.
I was going to call you, but I forgot.
Estábamos muy sorprendidos.
We were very surprised.
La niña estaba asustada.
The girl was scared.
Pasamos una semana en Cancún.
We spent a week in Cancún.
La mujer me contó una historia increíble.
The woman told me an amazing story.
Podía nadar muy bien de niño.
I could swim very well as a child.
Por fin pude hablar con él.
At last I managed to talk to him.
